followup_explanation:
This was a straightforward routing decision based on capability fit:

1. **Nature of the task** — This is a general knowledge/explanatory writing request ("describe how ML leads to better decision making"). It maps to general reasoning and clear, well-structured prose. There's nothing harm-adjacent or sensitive here, so the moderation/desensitization specialization that distinguishes the two models doesn't favor either one.

2. **Capability advantage** — With the special-purpose preferences being irrelevant, I defaulted to raw capability. Dunlin-235B leads Lapwing on every relevant metric by margins well outside run-to-run variance: MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 74.8), GPQA Diamond (64.1 vs 54.3), Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4), and Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8). Arena-Hard and Creative Generation are especially pertinent since the user wants a coherent, non-rambling, well-organized answer.

3. **The user's explicit ask** — They want something tight and coherent ("don't waffle on… just give me something coherent"). The stronger instruction-following and generation scores on Dunlin make it the better bet for a focused, quality response.

In short: no preference dimension broke the tie, so I routed to the more capable model.
